mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalAccumulatedRevenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'COMPLETED' AND p.payment_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last30DaysAccumulatedRevenue FROM payment p JOIN training t ON p.training_id = t.id WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId}

SELECT t.id AS training_id, t.title AS training_title, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS accumulated_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'COMPLETED' AND p.payment_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_30_days_accumulated_revenue FROM training t LEFT JOIN payment p ON t.id = p.training_id WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId} GROUP BY t.id, t.title ORDER BY t.id
